decision: Keep sibling git tags and widen recording_studio to >= 6.1.0 at gemspec load
why: Latest tags of Accessible, Attachable, Cache, Metrics, Root Switchable, Trashable, API, Admin, and Internationalization still constrain recording_studio below 5. No merged tag supports 6.1.
evidence: bundle install in root and test/dummy; loaded recording_studio 6.1.0, flat_pack 0.1.319, view_component 4.19.0

decision: configuration.layout defaults to nil and Layout.accept validates it. Controllers call recording_studio_layout. Public layout keeps an explicit false.
why: RS 6.1 resolves nil to the core layout, then recording_studio/default_layout. false must not fall through. Hardcoding the default layout name fails check_layouts.
evidence: configuration_test and published_controller_test; rake recording_studio:check_layouts exit 0

decision: Page titles go through content_for. Back and close go through flat_pack_page_nav. The empty clear-page-nav partial is gone.
why: RS 6 removed recording_studio_page_nav and the old content_for slots. An empty content_for is not present. Hosts use publishable_hides_page_nav_right?.

decision: Dummy overrides the default layout shell so html gets lang and the rounded theme, and registers host chrome before the nav is captured.
why: Core captures page nav before the head partial and has no html attribute slot. Tests require lang, data-theme, the language selector, and Sign out.

decision: Quick action dropdown builds button attributes from FlatPack::Button and keeps a raw trigger. The placements menu uses menu_html.
why: Flatpack 0.1.319 removed Button::Dropdown#button_attributes. Turbo still replaces the state span inside the trigger.

decision: Dummy language selector is one row, width w-44, left of the workspace switcher.
why: A stacked label is taller than the 96px top nav and was clipped. The i18n test requires the selector before the switcher.

decision: Do not move the language selector into the page column.
why: That placement fit the 96px nav, then CustomerI18nTest failed because the selector must sit left of the workspace switcher. The one-row override stays inside nav.right.

decision: The visible heading is the parent title. The document title can still prefer the SEO title.
why: content_for :title feeds FlatPack::PageTitle. Using publishable_document_title there showed the SEO title as the h1. Head tags still emit the SEO title.
evidence: published show test expects title Public page and heading from the parent

decision: Supersedes 23:00. Head tags do not emit the SEO title. Public pages set content_for :document_title from publishable_document_title. The visible heading stays content_for :title.
why: publishable_head_tags emits og:title from the social title. The 23:00 row named the wrong helper. Recording Studio's own layout still uses :title for the title element. The dummy layout and the bare engine layout read :document_title.
evidence: published_controller_test with seo_title Public page SEO

decision: Quick actions call trigger_button_arguments when Flatpack defines it, and Dropdown#button_attributes otherwise.
why: v0.1.315 still defines button_attributes. 0.1.319 removed it. The gemspec floor stays >= 0.1.315. The else branch is not executed in this bundle.
evidence: gh show of dropdown/component.rb at tag v0.1.315

decision: The bare engine layout is not a drop-in for the old shell. Sibling gems below recording_studio 5 will not resolve beside 0.12.0. The dummy Flatpack keyword patch stays dummy-only.
why: Hosts who set recording_studio_publishable/application lose the heading and nav because views no longer draw them. The widen helper is not shipped in the gem.

decision: Rows through 22:50 were written in one pass after the work, with ordered timestamps rather than clock times. 22:55 happened before 22:50 in the session.
why: The log was reconstructed. This row does not delete the earlier ones.

decision: The 390x844 hub shot shows English, Change language, Publish, and Launch Checklist.
why: The selector row fits. The earlier note that the shot was unchecked is closed by reading the image.
